decisions: Classify Ripple Treasury's $13T 2025 payments volume as a primary company statement from Ripple Treasury's April1 2026 launch announcement.
Do not classify the $13T as XRP/RLUSD settlement: it is 2025 payments volume, while native digital-asset account capabilities launched in April2026.
Record Ripple Treasury Digital Account Management as direct product support for viewing/holding/receiving/managing XRP and RLUSD balances in a regulated Ripple-native digital-asset account.
Do not infer customer XRP holdings, purchases, payment routing, or on-chain settlement from account-management capability.
Treat future cross-border/intercompany settlement and overnight repo expansion as planned until production evidence is found.
No directional market feature is admitted; no forecast is issued.
required_verification: Find current product terms, geographic availability and legal entity providing regulated Ripple-native digital asset accounts.
Seek customer case studies and actual XRP/RLUSD balance/transfer statistics.
Verify whether cross-border/intercompany settlement and overnight repo integrations have entered production.
Obtain asset-specific settlement share and collateral allocation before admitting any demand feature.
